newsitem.title: USA: Homestake claims best Santa Fe appreciation.
newsitem.headline: Homestake claims best Santa Fe appreciation.

text.p: Homestake Mining Co said Thursday its acquisition proposal continues to offer Santa Fe Pacific Gold Corp shareholders the best ownership structure and appreciation potential.

Homestake issued a statement in response to the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission's decision that the payment by Santa Fe Pacific of a break-up fee of $65 million to Homestake would not prevent Newmont Mining Corp from using "pooling of interests" accounting treatment in any subsequent acquisition of Santa Fe.
"The value of Newmont's offer has continued to erode," Homestate continued.

"We strongly believe that it is in the best interest of Santa Fe shareholders to proceed as quickly as possible to complete the agreed merger with Homestake. We look forward to meeting with the Santa Fe board of directors in the near future to continue this process.
"Homestake's proposal continues to offer the best ownership structure and appreciation potential to Santa Fe shareholders, who will own 50 percent of the new Homestake."
